title: Absorbed fair walk
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mathcal{A})$ be a measurable space, let $\mu$ be a measure on it, let $(\mathcal{F}_t)_{t\in\mathbb{N}}$ be a filtration, and let $Y_t:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ be a sequence, with real parameters $a,b,\tau$. The sequence is an absorbed fair walk if $Y_0=a$ almost everywhere; each $Y_t$ is measurable with respect to $\mathcal{F}_t$; almost surely, every $Y_t$ lies in $[a-b,a+b]$ and has the form $a+\tau z$ for some integer $z$; and for every time $t$ and bounded continuous function $\varphi:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, the conditional expectation of $\varphi(Y_{t+1})$ given $\mathcal{F}_t$ equals almost everywhere $\varphi(Y_t)$ when $Y_t$ is at either boundary, and otherwise equals $\bigl(\varphi(Y_t+\tau)+\varphi(Y_t-\tau)\bigr)/2$.
hypotheses_covered: each value is adapted to the filtration
lattice and interval condition holds almost everywhere at every time
conditional transition identity holds almost everywhere at every time for every bounded continuous test function
